credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Portrait of O'Keeffe sitting on the wellhead, brushing the coat of one of her chows, in the courtyard of her Abiquiu house.  She is wearing a Marimekko patterned dress and a white head scarf, also visible in the foreground is a black purse with handles and paving stones.
title: Grooming Dogs, Abiquiu
